name: Bellibolt
description: Bellibolt, the Elefrog Pokémon, and the evolved form of Tadbulb. An Electric type.
pokedex_entries: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.
